02. About Me

Analytical thinking.
Practical engineering.

I work at the intersection of data analysis, business intelligence and software development. At SLT-Mobitel, my work focuses on understanding postpaid performance, customer behaviour and opportunities for growth.

My GitHub brings together projects in computer vision, image processing and web applications. I enjoy taking an idea from a dataset or a business requirement to something people can use.

My interests include intelligent systems, scalable applications and fraud detection models—with a focus on useful, understandable results.
